reference_prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Riverdrake creature reference using the supplied established side-view reference crop and the full view of its installed model. ONE full-body three-quarter studio view of the same friendly aquatic drake: rich azure/turquoise blue scale skin, cream throat/chest/belly, expressive golden-amber eyes, a broad modest dragon/reptile snout with a small friendly closed-mouth smile, a short upright neck, four sturdy quadruped limbs with visible shoulders/elbows and hips/knees, broad grounded feet with separate pale ivory claws, and a long thick tapering tail ending in a large blue fin fan. Preserve the blue/cream identity, cream flank spots, swept-back head fin crest, broad dorsal sail fins and warm golden-orange fin margins. Fins should be broad connected sculpted membranes with a few sturdy integrated ribs, not hair wires or floating shards. Neutral standing quadruped with four clearly separated grounded feet and space between limbs; straight body and relaxed complete tail extending to one side. Keep all fins, claws and the entire tail inside frame with generous margin. No wings, new horns, extra limbs, saddle, harness, equipment, clothing, human, text, ruler, red faction marks, particles or environment. Warm fin accents are orange/ochre, never oxblood/red. Clean detailed stylized game-creature reference, coherent broad scale groups and readable facial forms, not photorealistic reptile noise. Neutral light-grey studio background and soft lighting. This preserves the same current-roster Riverdrake, not a new species.
